column1: # 財務與商務
account|n.|帳戶|Open a [savings account].|請開立儲蓄帳戶。
balance|n.|餘額|Check your [account balance].|請查詢帳戶餘額。
payment|n.|付款|Your [payment is due] tomorrow.|您的款項明天到期。
transaction|n.|交易|Keep the [transaction record].|請保留交易紀錄。
withdrawal|n.|提款|A [cash withdrawal] requires identification.|現金提款需要身分證明。
loan|n.|貸款|The bank approved our [business loan].|銀行核准了我們的企業貸款。
interest|n.|利息|The [interest rate] has fallen.|利率已下降。
mortgage|n.|房貸|They applied for a [home mortgage].|他們申請了房貸。
credit|n.|信用；信用額度|Your [credit limit] has increased.|您的信用額度已提高。
debit|n.|扣款|Use your [debit card].|請使用簽帳金融卡。
currency|n.|貨幣|We accept [local currency].|我們接受當地貨幣。
rate|n.|比率；費率|Check the [exchange rate].|請查詢匯率。
tax|n.|稅|The price includes [sales tax].|價格包含銷售稅。
taxation|n.|課稅；稅制|The seminar covers [corporate taxation].|講座涵蓋企業課稅。
deduction|n.|扣除額|You may claim a [tax deduction].|您可以申請稅務扣除額。
audit|n.|稽核；審計|The [annual audit] starts Monday.|年度審計週一開始。
accountant|n.|會計師；會計人員|Our [accountant prepares financial reports].|我們的會計人員編製財務報告。
accounting|n.|會計|She studies [financial accounting].|她學習財務會計。
statement|n.|對帳單；聲明|Review your [bank statement].|請核對銀行對帳單。
asset|n.|資產|The building is a [valuable asset].|這棟建築是有價值的資產。
liability|n.|負債；責任|The loan is a [financial liability].|這筆貸款是一項金融負債。
debt|n.|債務|The firm reduced its [outstanding debt].|公司減少了未償債務。
capital|n.|資本|We need [additional capital].|我們需要額外資本。
investment|n.|投資|The fund made a [long-term investment].|基金進行了一項長期投資。
investor|n.|投資人|Each [investor received a report].|每位投資人都收到了一份報告。
dividend|n.|股利|Shareholders received a [cash dividend].|股東收到了現金股利。
shareholder|n.|股東|Every [shareholder can vote].|每位股東都可以投票。
equity|n.|股權；淨值|The fund invests in [private equity].|這個基金投資私募股權。
bond|n.|債券|She purchased a [government bond].|她購買了一張政府債券。
portfolio|n.|投資組合|Review your [investment portfolio].|請檢視投資組合。
forecast|n.|預測|The [financial forecast] looks positive.|財務預測看來正面。
quarter|n.|季度|Sales grew [this quarter].|本季銷售成長了。
fiscal|adj.|會計年度的|Our [fiscal year] ends in March.|我們的會計年度在三月結束。
gross|adj.|總額的；未扣除的|The report shows [gross income].|報告列出了總收入。
net|adj.|淨額的|Our [net profit] increased.|我們的淨利增加了。
margin|n.|利潤率；差額|The [profit margin] is narrow.|利潤率很低。
overhead|n.|營運間接費用|We must reduce [office overhead].|我們必須減少辦公室間接費用。
expenditure|n.|支出|Track your [monthly expenditure].|請追蹤每月支出。
reimbursement|n.|費用報銷|Submit a [reimbursement request].|請提交費用報銷申請。
installment|n.|分期付款|The [first installment] is due today.|第一期款項今天到期。
overdue|adj.|逾期的|Please settle [overdue invoices].|請支付逾期帳款。
outstanding|adj.|未清償的|Pay the [outstanding balance].|請支付未清償餘額。
affordable|adj.|負擔得起的|We offer [affordable prices].|我們提供負擔得起的價格。
profitable|adj.|有利潤的|The store is now [a profitable business].|這家店現在是一門有利潤的生意。
calculate|v.|計算|Please [calculate the total].|請計算總額。
allocate|v.|分配|We will [allocate funds] next month.|我們將於下個月分配資金。
